compute_mae: compute mean absolute error between predicted and target tensor values using the mae metric function
compute_mse: compute mean squared error between predicted and target tensor values using the mse metric function
compute_cosine_similarity: compute cosine similarity between predicted and target tensor embeddings using the cosine_similarity metric function
compute_per_atom_mae: compute per-atom mean absolute error normalized by atom count using the per_atom_mae metric function
evaluate_energy_forces_threshold: evaluate fraction of systems where energy and force errors are within specified thresholds
